name: library-v4
note: Every texture as a recipe rendered by id with its knobs (tools/texgen/recipes.py). size is the image's width in pixels; grid splits it into grid x grid frames. Kinds: shape (one sprite), flipbook (a sequence), sheet (variants), strip (tiles along its length), decal (a ground sprite seen from above), source (a tiling noise map, never uploaded).

shape/core_flash.use: the 1-2 frame white-hot centre of a hit (additive)

shape/soft_glow.use: a plain soft disc of light: contact glows on the floor, halos behind hot shapes

shape/soft_pool.use: a wide, flat pool of light with no hot spot: the contact glow under a flame, wider than its base

shape/cross_flare.use: glint before a hit, or the lens-flare cross at impact (additive, FacingCamera)

shape/godray_fan.use: frame-one radial spikes of a heavy hit (additive)

shape/aniso_shard.use: long shards with VelocityParallel and Squash; top follows the velocity

shape/ink_stroke.use: the black ink slash accent (normal blend, tinted black)

flip/burst_dissolve.use: the burst of a hit: bursts out, hollows, breaks up (OneShot)

flip/shock_ring.use: a shock ring that thins and breaks into arcs (OneShot, flat)

flip/slash_erode.use: a crescent slash eroding from its tail (OneShot, VelocityPerpendicular, Emit 4)

flip/dust_ring.use: a ground dust ring from above (OneShot, flat, normal blend)

seq/slash_ribbon.use: a slash on mesh/crescent_* shells: 16 frames as separate images, swapped through TextureID

sheet/rock_chunks.use: flat rock debris instead of plain blocks (FlipbookStartRandom, framerate 0)

sheet/embers.use: hot fragments, one random variant per particle

sheet/bolt_variants.use: lightning bolts, one random variant per particle

strip/energy_streak.use: beams and trails that scroll (Wrap, TextureSpeed)

strip/fire_band.use: fire beams and trails that scroll

strip/lightning_fringe.use: electric fringe on a dash streak

art/brush_strokes.use: calligraphic strokes: ink accents and afterimage arcs

art/sigil_ornate.use: an ornate sigil coin (G's gold coins)

art/sigil_runes.use: a magic circle with rune glyphs

art/fringe_ring.use: a rainbow-fringe ring, the world-space chromatic fake (keep its colour: white tint)

art/ground_frost.use: frost ground sigil (decal or flat particle)

art/floor_streaks.use: radial streaks scored into the floor at a ground hit

art/dark_halo.use: negative space behind a flare (tinted black, normal blend)

source/fbm.use: tiling fBm for painting and erosion

source/worley.use: tiling Worley edges: cracked ground, ice

shape/star8.use: 8-point flare of a heavy hit (Bloom Strike)

shape/bokeh.use: soft depth discs behind a sigil

art/flower_sigil.use: flower sigil of petal strokes (Bloom Strike)

strip/pillar_streaks.use: vertical streaks for a pillar shell (u around, v up)

sheet/grass.use: dark grass blade clumps near the ground

strip/dome_glow.use: glow for mesh/dome (u around, v top to rim)

shape/impact_spikes.use: radial spike burst around a hollow centre: frame one of a hard hit

shape/vortex_ring.use: spiral vortex ring for a charge or suction (spin with RotSpeed)

shape/saw_ring.use: ring of outward shards: a sharp circle impact

shape/comic_burst.use: comic starburst splat with an outline (cel hits)

shape/halftone_disc.use: halftone-dot glow, the printed anime look

sheet/star_set.use: star and sparkle variants, one per particle

strip/comb_fringe.use: hanging streak comb that frays a beam's edge (scroll it)

strip/helix_strands.use: strands twisting around a beam (scroll it)

strip/pulse_bars.use: bars pulsing down a beam (scroll it fast)

flip/flame_stylized.use: a looping stylized flame in three hard bands on a solid base, tapered tips, stepped on twos (Loop, 12 fps, white tint)

flip/flame_stylized_smooth.use: the same flame with every sim frame (Loop, 24-48 fps)

flip/flame_stylized_ink.use: the stepped flame with a thin dark-red ink outline, the hand-drawn look (Loop, 12 fps, white tint)

flip/flame_lumpy.use: the flame with rounded lumps instead of spikes, one white tone (alpha follows the heat) for the particle to colour, its base faded out: for the splash, many of them flung out of the spot at once so the burst reads as volume (Loop)

flip/flame_strands.use: the stepped flame's tongues alone, standing strands with no body under them: for the splash, flung with the lumps (Loop)

flip/flame_stylized_hot.use: the stepped flame on a hotter rounded base: the cream core fills the bowl (Loop, 12 fps, white tint)

flip/flame_seated.use: the stepped flame on a clean base (ref 013): hottest at the bottom with no rim, fading softly into a contact glow on the floor; drawn in each cell's top half so the billboard pivots on its base: place the particle on the floor at twice the flame's height; draw it as light (Loop, 12 fps, white tint)

flip/flame_seated_out.use: flip/flame_seated burning out, top down: the heat falls, the tips go first and the base last (OneShot at 18 fps, 0.89 s). It starts on the loop's frame 15, so it takes over from a loop that began 15/18 s earlier without a jump; the tongues get shorter and softer as it dies

flip/flame_seated_single.use: flip/flame_seated in one white tone (its alpha follows the heat), coloured by the particle: several spread round the core make the burning fire (Loop)

flip/flame_seated_out_single.use: flip/flame_seated_out in one white tone, the single-tone flames' burn-out (OneShot)

flip/flame_lick.use: one stylized flame tongue, start to end: it flares, breaks off, thins and dies (OneShot). Many, rising out of one core flame, make a fire's volume

flip/flame_lick_base.use: the lick drawn in each cell's top half, so the billboard pivots on its base: emit it from the floor at twice the lick's height (OneShot)

flip/flame_lick_ink.use: the same lick with the dark-red ink line (OneShot)

art/ground_cracks.use: glowing ground cracks under a fire: Voronoi cells growing outward, hot at the centre, reaching half way out (Phát: a smaller patch, cells the same size) (additive decal or flat particle, white tint)

art/plate_cracks.use: lava-plate ground cracks under a fire, laid out from the impact: small plates at the middle, long cracks running out to large plates at the rim, weaker rings between, seams thick and hot at the middle thinning to red tips (Phát's pick C, after the fire pit reference) (additive decal or flat particle, white tint)

flip/plate_cracks_reveal.use: art/plate_cracks running out from the impact along their seams, hot at the front, in 4 frames (OneShot, then swap to art/plate_cracks)

flip/ground_cracks_spread.use: the same cracks spreading out from the centre with a hot leading edge, then holding (OneShot, about 0.5 s, then swap to art/ground_cracks)

sheet/brush_flicks.use: 16 hard-edged painted strokes (flick, thorn, comma, crescent, lick) in two grey bands, to tint: shards, licks, peels, slash accents

sheet/brush_flicks_ink.use: the same strokes in the fire ramp with a thin dark ink line, the Valorant thorn look (white tint, normal blend)

flip/smoke_cel.use: a cel-shaded cartoon smoke puff in two grey tones that swells, drifts and breaks up through big holes; tint dark for fire smoke, pale for dust (OneShot, normal blend)

flip/smoke_tongue.use: black smoke tongues (the fire pit's f16-25): the lick's torn, crisp-edged silhouette in two grey tones; tint near black, see-through, normal blend (OneShot)

flip/smoke_ball.use: one cel-shaded smoke ball that swells and breaks up; emit many, overlapping and unrotated, for a smoke volume (OneShot, normal blend)

flip/smoke_ball_soft.use: the smoke ball between cel and realistic: two tones with a soft edge and a wispy, see-through body (OneShot, normal blend, emit many overlapping)

sheet/flame_jet.use: four flame jets for an ignition: tapered, three bands, a few hooks swept back; each drawn in its cell's top half, base on the centre line, so a still particle on the spot pivots on the jet's base (VelocityParallel)

sheet/flame_shards.use: 16 spiky flame shards, jagged like flame-coloured lightning, pointing up the cell (VelocityParallel)

sheet/flame_ribbons.use: 16 thin ribbons of flame peeling up off a fire, tapered at both ends with a gentle S, one white tone for the particle to colour (the fire pit's f16-30 licks)

shape/shard_burst.use: the fire pit's shard ring: thorns scattered on a ring, merged where close and smeared outward (thorn_burst, after VFX_Haku's Substance graph), brightest in each piece's middle, only its top half, centred on the floor; it holds its shape, swells a little, brightens and fades

art/ground_scorch.use: the scorch on the floor: a dark ragged disc with dark spikes radiating out (flat, normal blend, tint dark)

art/scorch_rays.use: the scorch under the fire pit's cracks: art/scorch_smudge's soft dark blot with long soot rays of uneven length that smudge and fade toward their tips, like the reference's black streaks (Phát: A + B) (a decal, normal blend, tinted black)

art/scorch_smudge.use: the smooth scorch under the fire pit's cracks: a soft dark blot with long smudged rays (a decal, normal blend, tinted near-black; Phát picked it over the spiky art/ground_scorch)

shape/hot_spot.use: the hot spot under a fire: a soft disc, cream-yellow in the middle, orange, red at its round edge (flat, as light, white tint)

beam/flame_spire.use: one flame jet for a Beam, traced from the fire pit's left jet (f8, unwarped): a flat base at the left edge, two peaks pointing right and a small tip on one flank, in two tones (a red-orange edge, a cream core) (TextureMode Stretch, TextureLength 1, Attachment0 at the base); it flashes in, narrows and stretches out on the Beam's properties

strip/beam_hooks.use: one streak for a beam, its edges bitten by wide curled hooks, tiling along U to scroll (TextureSpeed); taper with Width0/Width1 and slow it with the Beam's properties, not the texture

shape/mold_fire_hook.use: molded by hand in the mold page (tools/texgen/molds/fire_hook.json), shaded in code
